metadata.description: Algeria administrative locations: 69 wilayas (Loi 26-06 2025/2026 reform), 1541 communes, real Algerie Poste postal codes. postalPrefix is the official first-two-digits actually used by Algerie Poste: for wilayas 01-58 it equals the wilaya number; for the 11 new wilayas 59-69 Algerie Poste still uses the historical parent-wilaya prefix (e.g. Aflou 59 -> 03, Messaad 69 -> 17). Only postal codes that follow this real prefix rule are kept, so every code is real and wilaya-bound.
